what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Honduras, counted by IDMC and by UNHCR, shown side by side and never added together.
At the end of 2025, IDMC counted 100637 people living in internal displacement because of conflict and violence, and UNHCR counted 423845 internally displaced people of concern to it.
Refugees from Honduras live mostly in Mexico and the United States.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict for Honduras; IDMC counts displacement from conflict and violence.
Storms, floods, mass movements and extreme temperatures are the disasters recorded for Honduras in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figures rose from 29356 in 2014 to 247090 in 2019 and were lower by the end of 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2015 to 2022.

how.text: The sources don't say where displaced people are living or which routes they took.
IDMC also counts new displacements in each year, which count movements, not people, so someone forced to move twice is counted twice.
